title: ID0367728-DC/SI-D/AE-[MP / R6 170002057] No HTTP Connection for Router-2
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
No HTTP Connection for Router-2
Root cause: Ethernet cable for Internet not properly connected, OCPP url Modified:
Solution: OCPP url:wss://wrenev.net:443/ocpp16, Changed Internet cable from LAN to WAN.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens Employee
Warranty Status:07/10/2025
Note:Site intervention on 17/07/24

additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek,
Greetings of the day.
I have checked the router settings through SSH.
It is set to Wired network
But we WAN connection is not being detected
Even from LAN configuration we can see that LAN setting is correct and working but WAN port is not working.
Please check the following on site
If light under WAN port is glowing or not
WAN cable is properly inserted into the WAN Port
Internet cable connecting XF4 to customer's router/switch is working fine.
If all these are ok then we need to replace XF4 as WAN port is not working.
As you also mentioned that you were not able to access router, where you connecting cable from your laptop directly to router or switch? Were you able to access XF3 from the same laptop?
Awaiting your response
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
